migrations.name: current_schema
migrations.rollback: recreate the unopened database before production launch
migrations.forwardRepair: recreate the unopened database and rerun the current baseline

migrations.name: initialize_login_security_settings
migrations.rollback: delete the singleton only before any Admin traffic is served
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent singleton insert and verify the CAPTCHA endpoint

migrations.name: add_announcements
migrations.rollback: drop announcement_receipts and announcements only before any announcement is published
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent role provisioning after applying the announcement tables

migrations.name: add_asset_quota_release
migrations.rollback: drop assets.quota_released_at only before deploying quota-release-aware application code
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent ALTER TABLE and verify the column exists

migrations.name: add_user_public_profiles
migrations.rollback: drop user_public_profiles only before any public profile or consent is stored
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent profile table and index creation migration

migrations.name: add_community_content
migrations.rollback: drop community_reports, community_post_tags and community_posts only before accepting the first submission
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent community content table and index creation migration, then reprovision database roles

migrations.name: add_generation_task_records
migrations.rollback: drop generation_task_records only before any task record is stored
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent task record table and index creation migration, then reprovision database roles
